sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Bharat Kumar Dixit
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Bharat Kumar Dixit, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Arpit Kumar,
the learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No.922 of 2019, under Sections 323, 506, 376 I.P.C., registered at Police Station - Kotwali Nagar, District - Raebareli.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 27.11.2019 against the applicant, his brother and father, stating that the informant got married to the applicant's brother - co-accused Abdul alisa Aftab; that she had gone to her matrimonial home from the Family Court on 14.09.2019 that all the accused persons used to harass her.

The FIR alleges that commission of rape Abdul Malik Alisa Mahtab vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175277771/

sentences.text: but neither any date of incident has been mentioned in the FIR nor is the allegation supported by medico legal examination report.
4. Earlier the applicant had filed Writ Petition No.34874 (MB) of 2019 and his arrest was stayed till filling of chargesheet by means of an order dated 16.12.2019.
Chargesheet has been submitted on 06.04.2020 and the applicant has approached this Court after receiving summons from the trial court.

5. In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has no criminal history and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that from the allegation, it appears that there is a matrimonial dispute between the informant and the applicant's brother-co-accused Abdul alisa Aftab; that the allegations levelled against the applicant are not supported by the medico legal examination report of the victim; that the applicant's arrest had previously been stayed by a Division Bench of this Court; that the applicant has no criminal history and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
